task: NanoClaw reliability, isolation, media handling, and agent quality overhaul
context: Multi-day session fixing claw stability, adding group isolation for guest users (chinnu-claw, ishi-claw), media handling (GIFs, video, audio transcription), intelligent model routing, message spam prevention, URL validation, and agent personality/quality improvements
next_steps: Rebuild container image — current containers still run old code without rate limiter and noise filter
Verify noise filter catches all narration patterns ('Let me...', 'I'll...', 'Checking...', '...' endings)
Monitor chinnu-claw and ishi-claw for 24h to confirm spam is reduced from 68/day to <5/day
Fix the 'Safety constraints noted' leak — comes from safety hook, needs to be suppressed at source
Clean stale auth sync keys if WA 408 loop returns (find . -name '*.json' ! -name 'creds.json' -delete in store/auth/)
Add jyotish tools to integration boundary (ultrareview bug_013 — on kanban)
blockers: Container image needs rebuild to deploy rate limiter + noise filter to container-side code
WA auth expires periodically — needs QR re-scan (no automated fix possible)
decisions_made: Streaming buffer: accumulate all chunks, send ONE message when agent finishes turn (was sending every chunk as separate WA message)
Noise filter at host level: suppress '.', 'Acknowledged', 'Standing by', 'Let me check...', short '...' messages before they reach WhatsApp
send_message rate limiter: scheduled tasks get 2 max, guest conversations 8, main 50
URL validation at code level: every URL in streaming output, IPC messages, and file attachments gets validated before delivery
Context-aware model routing: Haiku classifies using full context (recent messages + tasks.md), not just latest message
Per-group media directories: guests can only see their own media, not shared pool
isolatedPersona=true default for all non-main groups: no global CLAUDE.md access
Auto-capture (tasks, shared items) scoped to main group only — guest content never enters brain digest
Bot message detection fix: require fromMe=true for 'Claw:' prefix check — prevents quoted replies from being misclassified
Removed 'content NOT LIKE Claw:%' backstop from getNewMessages — caused false negatives on quoted replies
2-hour absolute container lifetime — prevents zombie containers from clogging the queue
process.exit removed from WA watchdog, QR auth, logged-out handlers — reconnect instead of kill
approaches_tried: Hard message limit (5) — too restrictive, broke multi-turn conversations. Changed to soft 3 + hard 8/10
LaunchD bootstrap/load for restart — unreliable after crash loops. kickstart -k works better
Persona embedding at startup — hung on Gemini API. Made non-blocking (fire-and-forget)
WA connect in constructor — baileys native crash with empty auth. Fixed by catching QR auth gracefully
critical_files: src/index.ts — streaming buffer, noise filter, auto-capture scoping, model routing
src/ipc.ts — send_message URL validation, send_file URL validation + mimetype detection, shared_items scoping, streaming_message auth
src/channels/whatsapp.ts — bot message detection fix, GIF/sticker/audio handling, media per-group copy
src/container-runner.ts — per-group media mounts, 2hr absolute lifetime, network default fix
src/db.ts — deleteSession, removed content NOT LIKE backstop
src/logger.ts — EADDRINUSE tolerance, SIGTERM instead of exit(1)
container/agent-runner/src/ipc-mcp-stdio.ts — send_message rate limiter, list_groups isolation, semantic_search scoping
container/agent-runner/src/index.ts — session resume fallback, CLAW_* env var isolation, isScheduledTask flag
groups/chinnu-claw/CLAUDE.md — elite agent personality, silent execution, one-message delivery
groups/guest-template/CLAUDE.md — default template for all new groups
